text:
No hiring option can be put forward from this run.

- The **£400k/year annual-salary-spend limit was not checked**: the model treats salary spend as a calculated quantity on a different frame from the constraint, so it was excluded rather than scored incorrectly.
- The comparison is **fragile** and outcomes were nearly identical. Platform delivery capacity is the most sensitive assumption; it is an Olumi estimate, as are the other inputs behind this provisional run.
- The goal’s direction was not stated, so the analysis assumed that a higher goal value is preferable.
